_readme: Release register for the Kitchen and Garage survey funnels. 'recorded_facts' are statements already verified or confirmed, with their source. They are NOT approvals and never clear the gate. 'items' are what still needs a human decision. The release gate (tests/survey/privacy-approval.js) fails while any item with blocking:true is not status:confirmed with confirmed_by and confirmed_on (YYYY-MM-DD). Claude Code must never confirm an item on the business's behalf. Each item has a type: 'factual' (a fact only the business can state), 'compliance' (a legal or compliance judgement), or 'technical'. Evidence: docs/SURVEY-PRIVACY-NOTICE-APPROVAL.md.

recorded_facts.statement: info@wren-builders.com is APPROVED as the privacy contact email for both the Kitchen and Garage surveys, and is a real Wren Builders business address.
recorded_facts.provenance: Selection approved by the business owner's representative in the release session, 11 Nov 2026. Address verified by Codex, 11 Nov 2026: shown in GHL Location Settings, Business Profile and Harry Wren's GHL user record, and an earlier GHL internal notification sent to it was opened.
recorded_facts.limits: Selection only. It does not confirm the mailbox is routinely monitored (UNKNOWN, see item privacy_mailbox_monitored). It is not the automation sender hello@email.wren-builders.online, which is unchanged.

recorded_facts.statement: Existing GHL automation email sender is hello@email.wren-builders.online. It is unchanged and is not used as the privacy contact.
Routine monitoring of info@wren-builders.com is UNKNOWN.
recorded_facts.limits: Awaiting business confirmation. Tracked as blocking item privacy_mailbox_monitored.

recorded_facts.statement: Harry's initial SMS is an enquiry response, not separate marketing.
recorded_facts.provenance: Stated by the business owner's representative in the release session, 11 Nov 2026. No name and date signature yet.
recorded_facts.limits: The stop-request route and 'no marketing without permission' are still open (item sms_and_calls).

recorded_facts.statement: The existing Kitchen £1,000 appliance upgrade and Garage free AC campaigns are running separately. Preserve the existing creative unless a specific factual claim is disproven.
recorded_facts.provenance: Stated by the business owner's representative in the release session, 11 Nov 2026.
recorded_facts.limits: Confirms the offers exist and the creative stays. It does not attest the scarcity, 'reserved', timing, response-time or review claims (item offer_claims_true).

recorded_facts.statement: Outside-Cornwall enquiries are stored and tagged in GHL, with no opportunity, Sheets row, internal notification or Harry SMS.
recorded_facts.provenance: Business confirmed; matches Codex's published workflow state; hosted v2 test read back the contact and tag.

recorded_facts.statement: The Garage AI-generated hero image was explicitly approved by A2B for launch. A real client photograph is optional, not a launch dependency.
recorded_facts.provenance: Stated by the business in the release session, 11 Nov 2026, reconciling the original Claude Design handoff. The repo was searched: no document claims the image is client-approved.
recorded_facts.limits: Approved by A2B, NOT by the client. Do not describe it as client-approved: no client evidence exists. The older note in garage-conversion/WREN-GARAGE-HANDOFF.md ('garage conversion photography is still needed') is historical, sits in the untouched legacy folder, and is superseded. Not a blocker.

recorded_facts.statement: The Kitchen line 'Book this month to secure your upgrade' was approved by A2B. No replacement fixed book-by date was supplied and none is required for the funnel.
recorded_facts.provenance: Stated by the business in the release session, 11 Nov 2026.
recorded_facts.limits: Still part of the launch-day attestation: the upgrade must be honoured for people who book in the month they enquire.

recorded_facts.statement: Reassurance copy, error messages, button labels, page titles and review labels were approved provisionally by A2B, pending final sign-off.
recorded_facts.provenance: Stated by the business in the release session, 11 Nov 2026.
recorded_facts.limits: Provisional. Final sign-off is part of blocking item offer_claims_true.

recorded_facts.statement: The original .dc.html redirect targets were export placeholders and have been replaced. The webhook and tracking handover has been implemented.
recorded_facts.provenance: Repo check, 11 Nov 2026: no .dc.html reference, no WREN_WEBHOOK or WREN_THANK_YOU placeholder and no x-import tag in any survey page or in survey/wren-funnel.js. Routes are absolute /survey/... paths, the webhook is server-side only, tracking is consent-gated. The release gate now enforces this.
recorded_facts.limits: survey/support.js (the Design Component runtime, byte-identical to garage-conversion/support.js) is still used by the survey pages and is self-hosted. Its internal .dc.html, unpkg and Babel code paths are dormant: tests prove zero unpkg and Babel requests. The live legacy /kitchen and /garage-conversion pages are untouched and still use their own .dc.html files.

recorded_facts.statement: Meta ad account 'Wrenbuildersaccount1' has 7 ACTIVE ads, all in the campaign 'A2B | Garage Conversion + Free AC | Conversions | Leads | IF'. No Kitchen ads were ACTIVE.
recorded_facts.provenance: Read-only Meta Ads API check, 11 Nov 2026. Nothing changed.
recorded_facts.limits: The API returned no primary text, headline or link URL for these post-backed ads, so expired deadlines in the live ad text could NOT be checked. A person must read the ad text in Ads Manager before the URL switch (part of item offer_claims_true).

items.title: Sign-off of the final Privacy Notice and the text under the submit button
items.detail: Includes the lawful bases stated in notice section 3 (Article 6(1)(b), 6(1)(f) and consent for optional cookies). These were adopted from standard UK practice on the business's 11 Nov instruction. They are not yet recorded in a legitimate interests assessment or record of processing.

items.title: Calls and texts: stop route and no marketing without permission
items.detail: Recorded already: Harry's first text is an enquiry response, not separate marketing. Still to confirm: (a) a person who replies 'stop' or asks us to stop is removed from texts and calls (GHL do-not-disturb is honoured), and (b) no marketing text or email is sent without separate permission. Notice section 4 states both.

items.title: Service-provider list is complete
items.detail: The notice lists GoHighLevel, Google Sheets, Vercel and 'the agency and IT providers that manage our advertising and systems'. Confirm there is no other processor (for example a separate SMS carrier or email provider chosen by the business) and that data processing terms are in place with each.

items.title: Privacy contact email for the survey Privacy Notice
items.detail: CONFIRMED: info@wren-builders.com, used in notice sections 1 and 10. Selection only. Monitoring is a separate pending item (privacy_mailbox_monitored). The GHL automation sender hello@email.wren-builders.online is preserved and unchanged.
items.confirmed_by: Wren Builders owner's representative (instruction to Claude Code in the release session)

items.title: info@wren-builders.com is read routinely, and someone answers privacy requests within one month
items.detail: The address is verified as a Wren business address (see recorded fact privacy_contact_email) but monitoring is UNKNOWN. Also confirm who handles replies sent to the automation sender hello@email.wren-builders.online, since people may reply to automated emails. Do not change the sender.

items.title: International transfer safeguard exists for each non-UK provider
items.detail: GoHighLevel, Vercel, Google and Meta process data in the US. Confirm each has a valid UK transfer mechanism (UK-US data bridge certification, or standard contract terms with the UK Addendum). The notice does not name the mechanism.

items.title: Retention criteria and the purpose for keeping outside-Cornwall enquiries
items.detail: Notice section 3 and 7 state criteria, not a fixed period. Confirm the criteria and the purposes stated for outside-Cornwall records (a note of the enquiry, dealing with them getting back in touch, advert measurement) are correct and that records are deleted when no longer needed or on request.

items.title: ICO data protection fee paid or exemption confirmed
items.detail: No registration number is published or invented. The business must confirm its fee status with the ICO.

items.title: Launch copy signed off, and remaining claims true on the launch date
items.detail: Recorded already: both campaigns are running and the creative stays; the Garage AI hero and the Kitchen 'Book this month' line were approved by A2B (no replacement date needed); reassurance copy, error messages, button labels, page titles and review labels were approved provisionally. Still to sign off and attest as true on launch day: Garage 'limited to 3 homeowners' and 'only taking on 3 garage conversions this month'; 'reserved' on both thank-you pages; 'Book this month to secure your upgrade' honoured for people who book that month; 'reach out within a few hours'; 'fixed quote with no hidden costs'; 'Free home visit'; 'We'll call you from 01872 613608'; kitchen 'Before Christmas'; the review labels and the 'Cornwall homeowners' heading; '100% would come back'; and the provisional copy as a whole. Also read the live ad text in Ads Manager and confirm no ad still carries an expired date (the API could not show it). Exact text: docs/SURVEY-RELEASE-APPROVAL.md section 4.

items.title: Set a fixed retention period and a deletion routine (recommended)
items.detail: Criteria are enough to publish. A number and a routine (for example a GHL workflow that deletes DQ contacts after a set time) would be stronger. No such automation exists today.

items.title: Write down the legitimate interests assessment and the record of processing (recommended)
items.detail: Internal records. Not published, not checked by code.

items.title: Vercel firewall rate limit on /api/survey-lead (recommended)
items.detail: The endpoint is public and active GHL sales actions are attached. Needs approval to change Vercel configuration.

items.title: Remove the Preview test contacts from GHL
items.detail: Owned by Codex. Not deleted from here.

items.title: Review or remove 'Before Christmas' after 25 Dec 2026
items.detail: Kitchen option 'Before Christmas' and 'Book soon to get fitted before Christmas' become a stale deadline after 25 Dec 2026. A date-sensitive reminder, not a launch blocker.
